meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.ModeVelo: The source contains this interface and conditional consumers, while modeVelocityCoef_holds proves the downstream ModeVelocityCoefStatement directly. The separate intermediate identity has not been assigned a discharger. The direct coefficient estimate is the named result used in the assembled energy-tail route.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.SharpEne: Lean's real-valued infinite sum is zero when its family is not summable; this inequality by itself does not assert convergence.
No summability hypothesis is imposed here; the later energy estimates provide the convergence needed for their analytic use.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnAdjI: The formula uses Lean's total division; invertibility at admissible frequencies is supplied by separate hypotheses and lemmas.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayou: Symmetry of the mode set is needed to remove the fallback branch.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.FaceTrace: faceTraceFree_of has the extra guard i = 0 -> K.r₁ ≠ 0, as well as AxisGradModeIntegrableStatement. The interface omits that guard. The strain-face proof uses the permitted radial side and handles height traces separately. The full unguarded interface is kept separate from this route.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potential: The default value has mathematical meaning only after a separate existence hypothesis identifies it with a valid potential.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsSystemIn: This specialization belongs to the fractional statement layer; it should retain its exponent when compared with the ordinary Navier-Stokes paper.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.inverseSqu: The fallback retains the raw remainder with an empty harmonic set; later existence and support conditions justify use of the selected branch.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.ProfileDa: Existence must be established separately before this selected field can discharge a fractional-power obligation.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData.mi: Positive definiteness in valid row data supplies the Hermitian and invertibility properties used by subsequent normalization proofs.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.Spectral.IsSpectralDa: Axis blocks additionally have inner radius and angular mode zero and satisfy cutoff times radial width squared at least twenty-four; the polynomial block degree is at least one.
